verses.text: 📜 APOCALYPSE OF ABRAHAM
In the days of Terah my father, I sought to know the God who created heaven and earth.
And I said within myself:
“Who is he that made the heavens and the earth?”
And I looked at the sun, and it shone greatly, and I said:
“Surely the sun is God.”
But when it set, I said:
And I looked upon the moon and the stars, and I said:
“Perhaps these are God.”
But when clouds covered them, I said:
“They also are not God.”
And I saw that all things were made and perished.
“None of these can be the true God.”
And I sought Him who created all.
And I saw my father making idols, and I laughed at them.
For they could not move nor speak.
“These are not gods.”
And I took one of the idols and broke it.
And my father was angry with me.
“Why do you worship that which cannot save?”
And I burned the idols with fire.
And I saw that they were consumed.
“If they were gods, they would save themselves.”
And I heard a voice from heaven saying:
“Leave thy father’s house, and seek Me.”
And I trembled at the voice.
And I went forth, not knowing where I went.
And the voice guided me.
And I saw the heavens opened.
And a great light surrounded me.
“I am the God who created all things.”
And I fell upon my face.
And He commanded me to prepare a sacrifice.
And to be ready for what He would show me.
And it came to pass when I had prepared the sacrifice as I had been commanded, that there came a voice unto me saying:
And I said: “Here am I.”
And He said: “Behold, I have sent unto thee a messenger, that he may guide thee.”
And I looked, and behold, there stood before me an angel, and his appearance was terrible and glorious.
And his voice was like the roaring of many waters.
And he said unto me: “I am Yahoel, who standeth in the presence of the Lord.”
And he said unto me: “Be not afraid, Abraham, for the Lord hath chosen thee.”
“And thou shalt see great things which no man hath seen.”
And he commanded me to stand and prepare for ascent.
And I arose, trembling, and followed the angel.
And he took me up, and we ascended through the firmament.
And I saw the expanse of the heavens, and the powers that were therein.
And we ascended higher, and I saw hosts of angels praising the Lord.
And their voices were like thunder, and their praise was unceasing.
And I fell upon my face.
And the angel said unto me: “Stand, Abraham, and behold.”
And I saw a great throne, and upon it sat the Lord in glory.
And I trembled and could not look upon Him.
And the angel strengthened me, and I looked again.
And I saw the order of creation, and how all things were arranged.
And I saw the earth and all that was upon it.
And I saw the abyss and the depths, and the place of punishment.
And I saw the place of the righteous, where there was light and peace.
And I saw the generations of men, and how they walked in righteousness or wickedness.
And their deeds were revealed before the Lord.
And I saw the adversary, and his works among men.
And how he deceived them and led them astray.
And I was shown the corruption of the earth.
And I said unto the Lord: “Why hast Thou allowed this to be?”
“For a time I permit it, but judgment shall come.”
And it came to pass that I saw the whole world, and all that is therein.
And I saw the peoples and nations, and how they were divided.
And I saw that many walked in darkness, and few in righteousness.
And I saw a great judgment seat, and books were opened.
And all men were judged according to their works.
And the righteous were separated from the wicked.
And I saw the inheritance of the righteous, and it was full of light and joy.
And I saw the punishment of the wicked, and it was darkness and torment.
And the Lord said unto me:
“These are the things which shall come to pass in the last days.”
“And I will judge all flesh according to their deeds.”
And I saw a chosen one, who was set apart.
And through him many were justified.
And he stood against the adversary.
And I saw the covenant established with the righteous.
And they were given a place among the elect.
And they rejoiced before the Lord.
And I saw the destruction of the wicked, and their works came to nothing.
And they were cast away, and their memory perished.
And I saw the renewal of the earth, and it was made clean.
And righteousness dwelt therein.
And the Lord said unto me:
“Abraham, these are the things that thou hast seen.”
“And thou shalt declare them to thy descendants.”
